body:
Okapi CR 1/2

This creature looks like an amalgam of a horse and zebra, it chews while pausing to assess whether you are threat.

XP 200
N Medium animal
Init +6; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 11, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 13 (2d8+4)
Fort +5, Ref +4, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 450 ft
Melee 2 hooves +4 (1d4+3), slam -1 (1d4+4)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 13, Con 15, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 6
Base Attack +1; CMB +4; CMD 15 (19 vs. trip)
Feats Endurance(B), Run
Skills Perception +6

ECOLOGY

Environment warm plains
Organization solitary, mating pair
Treasure none

While these animals look like horses or zebras, they are actually a cousin of giraffe. They do not have the long necks of their larger cousins and do not approach them in size, but provoked, they can be very deadly. Some smaller people have managed to tame them as mounts.
